Parent Container

▽

Description
If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is true, the FrSM will check the wakeup reason in order
to skip the wakeup in case of wakeup by bus. If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is false,
the FrSM will always try to perform a wakeup.
